variants.headline: Still in view: party divides in two
variants.sub: A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}.
variants.body:
The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the division of the party without ascribing a particular doctrine or dispute to either part. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Still in view: a political organisation breaks apart
variants.sub: The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}.
variants.body:
A split in {party} has produced the new party {splinter}. This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event.

The gazette records the division of the party without ascribing a particular doctrine or dispute to either part. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Still in view: unity gives way to a party split
variants.sub: The party {party} has split, with {splinter} the new breakaway party.
variants.body:
The new party {splinter} has broken away from {party}. Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point.

The gazette records the division of the party without ascribing a particular doctrine or dispute to either part. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
